title: SEC1: harness_smoke_test duplicates spawn_test_listener test
description: crates/kithd/tests/harness.rs:290-307 vs crates/kithd/tests/e2e.rs:81-97. Both tests assert: bob_addr.ip() == LOCALHOST, port != 0, cert_der non-empty, TcpStream::connect succeeds. The harness smoke test adds state-counter and contacts checks (oracles 4-7) which are non-overlapping and should stay. But oracles 1-3 in harness_smoke_test are byte-for-byte identical to spawn_test_listener_binds_loopback_port. Maintainer burden: a failure in socket binding now produces two identical failures from two different test files, obscuring which layer broke.
